Who Can Join This Maha Hawan?

This transformative event is open to everyone seeking to renew their spiritual energy and cleanse their aura. Whether you’re just beginning your spiritual journey or have long practiced ancient rituals, the Maha Hawan is designed to serve all who wish to:
Eliminate Negative Energies: Protection against all types of Negativities Tattva: Black Magic, Pitra etc.
Enhance Spiritual Growth: Beneficial for both beginners and seasoned practitioners aiming to elevate their consciousness and unlock higher dimensions of energy..

No prior experience in spiritual practices is necessary—just an open heart and a willingness to embrace the transformative power of ancient rituals. Join us and step into a space of healing, renewal, and cosmic alignment this Maha Hawan!
Join the Maha Hawan
This sacred occasion is not just a celebration, but a powerful spiritual opportunity to receive Bhakti, Shakti, Vidya , and Divine Awakening through the Maha Havan.

FAQ'S
1. What is the Maha Hawan?
The Maha Hawan is scheduled on purnima every month. Please check our registration page for the exact date, time, and details on how to participate online or at Ashaeiynn venue.
2. What are the benefits of participating in the Maha Hawan?
Aspirant who wants to increase their dev kripa, activate or increase their bhakti tatva, dimensions , mool tattva & astral world capabilities.
3. What are the different Hawan slabs offered during the event?
We offer two specialized Havan slabs:
Sankalp Raksha Suraksha (₹3100): Protection against all types of Negativities Tattva: Black Magic, Pitra etc.
Jagriti Sankalp (₹4100): Activates your spiritual potential, awakens advanced chakra layers, and boosts your mantra shakti.
4. How do I register for the event?

Registration is simple. Visit our website’s event page (Ashaeiynn.com/maha-hawan), fill out the checkout page, choose the Havan slab that suits your needs, and complete the payment process. You will receive a confirmation email with further details. After that go to “Ashaeiynn App: – Then open Maha Hawan form and fill out the form so that your sankalp can be taken during Maha Hawan
5. Can I participate if I am new to spiritual practices?

Absolutely. The Maha Hawan is open to all who are the member of Ashaeiynn, regardless of experience level. Our experienced facilitators will guide you through the process, ensuring that you receive the full benefits of this transformative ritual.
